character: Car-free village in the Saas Valley surrounded by 4,000 m peaks, with glacier skiing on the Allalin (Fee) glacier up to about 3,600 m, served by the Metro Alpin underground funicular (reference). One of Switzerland's most snow-sure areas thanks to its altitude.
learning: Reference note: ski schools and nursery areas in the village. Confirm beginner zones and lesson products.

announcedOpening.text: Partial glacier reopening from 3 Oct 2026 (Allalin 2 and Allalin 3 lifts on the upper glacier)

source.note: Glacier skiing closed in early August 2026 by a heat wave (shared research notes)

season.typicalText: Glacier skiing from autumn (2026: from 3 Oct); winter season to around April (search summary: October to April)
season.notes: Only the partial glacier reopening (3 Oct 2026, earlier search summary) is on file. The official homepage advertises a 'Pre-Season Special 31.10. – 18.12.2026' and the Sleep & Ski Deal 2026/27, but no main-season dates. The Saas-Fee season pass is included in the Magic Pass.
